channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Struggles to return above 20-day EMA, eyes on Fed policy
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades marginally lower at around 1.1580 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair drops as the US Dollar (USD) rises, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement on Wednesday.

item.title: Bullock Speech: RBA Governor addresses press conference after pausing interest rate hikes
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock is speaking at the press conference, explaining the reasons behind leaving the benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.35% after the June monetary policy meeting.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as risk-off mood supports US Dollar
item.description: NZD/USD extends its losses for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5810 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds steady amid broad market caution.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD edges lower below $70.00 as bearish bias holds under 100-day SMA
item.description: Silver Price (XAG/USD) trades in negative territory around $69.85 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The white metal retreats from a weekly high as traders book some profits ahead of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades firmly amid signs of renewed FIIs’ interest towards Indian stock market
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens firmly against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds losses following RBA decision
item.description: AUD/USD pares its recent gains from the previous day, trading around 0.7050 during the Asian hours. The pair remains subdued as the Australian Dollar (AUD) struggles to shake off losses following the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) latest monetary policy update.

item.title: Australian Dollar retreats against New Zealand Dollar as RBA leaves rates steady at 4.35%
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) falls back to near 1.2150 from its intraday high of 1.2168 against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) after the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) monetary policy announcement.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as market caution lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 0.7950 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds steady amid broad market caution.

item.title: Oil: Hormuz risks keep supply outlook tense – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Global Daily highlights that reported progress on a US-Iran understanding has not removed key risks around the Strait of Hormuz, with only a brief memorandum agreed and major details still unclear.

item.title: Gold rises as US, Iran announce framework to end war
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains momentum during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The precious metal extends the rally after the United States (US) and Iran reached a comprehensive framework deal to end hostilities, easing inflation concerns.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens against Japanese Yen as BoJ hikes rate to highest since 1995
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross loses traction to around 113.20 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision.

item.title: Bank of Japan hikes interest rate by 25 bps to 1% as expected
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) announced on Tuesday that it increased the short-term interest rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 1% after concluding the two-day monetary policy review meeting.

item.title: Japanese Yen gives up some gains against Euro as BoJ hikes rates by 25 bps to 1%, as expected
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) surrenders some of its early gains against its major currency peers during the Asian trading session after the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Japanese Yen remains stronger as BoJ delivers a rate hike
item.description: USD/JPY depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 160.10 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair remains subdued as the Japanese Yen (JPY) holds ground following the release of the interest rate decision by the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds onto Monday’s gains near 99.70 ahead of Fed’s policy
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades firmly near Monday’s high ahead of the start of the two-day Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy meeting, whose decision will be announced on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound inches lower amid market caution ahead of US-Iran deal updates
item.description: GBP/USD loses ground after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 1.3400 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair inches lower as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from the market caution ahead of further developments regarding US-Iran peace talks.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens to near 0.5800 as China's Retail Sales fall short of estimates
item.description: The NZD/USD pair loses momentum to around 0.5810 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) following the Chinese economic data. All eyes will be on the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision later on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar falls further after weak China data
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) faces further selling pressure against its major currency peers during the Asian trading session on Tuesday, sliding 0.16% to near 0.7060 against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Canadian Dollar steadies as US Dollar holds ground amid market caution
item.description: USD/CAD remains stronger for the fourth successive day, trading around 1.3990 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair is holding its ground as the US Dollar (USD) stabilizes ahead of further developments regarding US-Iran peace talks.

item.title: China’s Retail Sales miss expectations in May: What -0.6% means for the Australian Dollar
item.description: China’s Retail Sales fell 0.6% year-over-year (YoY) in May vs. 0% expected and 0.2% in April, the latest data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) showed Tuesday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8108 vs. 6.8088 previous
item.description: On Tuesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8108 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8088 and 6.7605 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Japanese Yen drifts higher ahead of BoJ rate decision
item.description: The USD/JPY pair declines to around 160.15 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) following a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. All eyes will be on the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision later on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI hovers around $80.00 as traders await developments on US-Iran peace talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price inches higher after registering 3.7% losses in the previous day, trading around $80.10 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: US President Donald Trump declares Iran ‘has agreed to never have a nuclear weapon’
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that Iran agreed not to ever have a nuclear weapon, the Guardian reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Japan’s Kiuchi: No comment on market expectations of BoJ rate hike
item.description: Japan's Economy Minister, Minoru Kiuchi, said on Tuesday that he will participate in today's Bank of Japan (BoJ) meeting. Kiuchi added that he strongly hopes the central bank communicates and collaborates with govthe government sustainably and stably reach the 2% inflation target.

item.title: Euro edges higher to near 1.1600 on US-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1590 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. A deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz spurred a rally in riskier assets such as the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: British Pound Sterling's peace rally round-trips ahead of the Fed
item.description: GBP/USD opened the new week with a sharp risk-on pop toward 1.3450 as a US-Iran ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz sent Crude Oil tumbling and lifted risk-sensitive currencies. The entire move then unwound, leaving the pair back near 1.3400, almost exactly where it started.

item.title: The Bank of Japan can't save the Japanese Yen
item.description: USD/JPY is grinding into the Bank of Japan's (BoJ) June meeting above the 160.00 handle, a whisker from multi-decade highs, while the central bank meant to defend the Yen prepares to raise rates to a three-decade high without lifting the currency at all.

item.title: Australian Dollar advances as Hormuz breakthrough sinks USD and Oil
item.description: The Australian Dollar registered gains of over 0.37% on Monday as the US and Iran agreed on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at ending the conflict and setting the stage for talks about Tehran’s nuclear program.
